supersedes.reason: The 11:13 run enumerated derived edges ONLY in the graph each episode was read from, so the entire cross-graph population (21 findings whose graph_name differs from their group_id) shipped with an empty harm-artefact column — including 5 findings whose edges genuinely exist, in the other graph. The amendment pass batches the scan and asks the record's group_id graph too whenever that graph was swept; those 5 findings recovered 6-11 edges each (+41 edge uuids in total, 1116 -> 1157). Nothing was lost: every changed finding's edge set is a strict SUPERSET of the earlier one. No finding was added or dropped.

also_superseded.reason: The pre-fix run resolved its derived-edge reader by the record's Graphiti group_id (finding.project_id) against a reader dict keyed by the --project GRAPH NAMES. Any episode whose group_id differed from the graph it was read from therefore resolved to the wrong reader, or to no reader at all, and the miss serialized as `derived_edge_uuids: []` — indistinguishable from a measured zero. Fixed in steps 16-19 (commits b3b1ff99fb, dcfedcccd6, 041b6277f1, 994e6667f4): the lookup is keyed on the `graph_name` field (WHICH GRAPH WAS QUERIED), and a genuinely un-enumerated edge list serializes as JSON `null` with `edges_unqueried: true` rather than as an empty list.
